summary: SiteProfileHistory manages records of changes and actions associated with site profiles, providing detailed user and action history.
purpose: To track and store historical changes made to site profiles, including user actions and associated details.

workflows.name: Site Profile History Retrieval
steps: Query database for historical records based on SiteID and SessionAgencyID.
Fill list with retrieved records and return to caller.

conditions.name: User Action Filtering
conditions.description: Use alternate language fields if session indicates alternate language usage.

system_behavior: Retrieves and formats site profile history records.
Provides detailed formatting for user actions and agency details.
